edits.prompt: Edit the supplied original inventory icon. Preserve the entire beautiful acorn object, geometry, wood, gold, amber glass, coins, leaves, lighting, camera, colors and layout unchanged. ONLY remove all background: the pale white/green/grey opaque halo behind and between the top leaves and stem, and the glow haze outside the lower legs. Every pixel outside the actual object silhouette must be transparent alpha, including the holes between its feet and the spaces between leaves and stem. No glow, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow. Crisp clean cutout for display over a dark walnut UI. Do not erase the glass or gold inside the object.
